newsitem.title: USA: LaserVision says president Gillam resigns.
newsitem.headline: LaserVision says president Gillam resigns.

text.p: LaserVision Centers Inc said Friday that President Alan Gillam had left the company to pursue other business opportunities.
LaserVision Chairman and Chief Executive John Klobnak said the company would not fill the position of president.

"Mr Gillam's duties will be filled by several senior executives. Mr Klobnak remains chief executive officer and James Wachtman, executive vice president, remains chief operating officer," the company said.
LaserVision operates excimer lasers, which allow eye surgeons to correct nearsightedness in an outpatient procedure.
